title: 自验证蒸馏：语言模型自身作为合成数据管道
summary: 提出自验证蒸馏算法，让大语言模型仅使用无标签种子问题，通过自生成候选解、基于提示的自验证过滤（包括循环一致性、事实性和正确性检查），构建高质量自训练数据集，从而提升推理能力。在数学、科学和编程三个领域，Qwen3模型（0.6B/4B/8B）均取得显著性能提升。
summary_en: Proposes Self-Verified Distillation, a post-training refinement algorithm where LLMs generate candidate solutions to unlabeled seed questions, filter them via prompt-based self-verification (cycle-consistency, factuality, correctness), and train on the curated dataset. Achieves significant gains across math, science, and coding for Qwen3 models.
